fields.name: CaseId
fields.description: FK Case.itemId. Indexed for case history lookups.

fields.name: EventType
fields.description: created | note | ai_draft | ai_suggestion | sent_reply | status_change | approval_requested | approval_decided | closed. Distinguishes human vs AI entries (NFR-8).

fields.name: ActorUserId
fields.description: User.itemId of the actor (system if from a scheduler).

fields.name: Text
fields.description: Free-text content of the event (note / reply / AI output). Firewall-scanned before insert (FR-19).

fields.name: MetadataJson
fields.description: JSON string of structured metadata (e.g. draft/final text pair, AI model info). Append-only payload.

fields.name: AiGenerated
fields.description: True when the event's content was produced by the AI subsystem (NFR-8 auditability).
